searchText: These are really great docs, thank you!! out of curiosity, what's the 2-torsion of these curves? The small order subgroup is isomorphic to the klein-4 group or Z2XZ2 . The actual elements in that group are the identity point (0,1), a order 2 point (0,-1) and 2 exceptional points of order 2 Thanks, from reading your document it seemed you have been assuming that it was Klein's 4 group, didn't know if this was obviously known or not. Ah right, thats a good point, it could have been Z4. I think there is a proof that shows that this cannot happen if the curve is incomplete (I'll put this in my notes for refactoring as I don't think I wrote that proof down)
